items.title: RSU  Professors Launch AI-Powered Decision-Making Simulator  for Business Education  - Rogers State University
items.snippet: Rogers State University professors have developed an AI-enabled educational plat...
items.raw_snippet: Rogers State University professors have developed an AI-enabled educational platform to assist students with their leadership development, critical thinking, decision  making  and organizational problem-solving skills. Developed through an interdisciplinary collaboration between RSU Assistant Professor Dr. Nitindra Chowdary and Department of Business Instructor Bruce Richardson,  Simulance AI is a research tool which  creates an interactive environment where  a small group of students engage in realistic organizational challenges and decision-making exercises that mirror professional workplace environments. “Simulance  AI provides students with opportunities to develop these competencies through realistic executive simulations and interactive learning experiences.”. Beyond its immediate educational applications, the platform serves as a growing faculty-led research and innovation initiative exploring how artificial intelligence can enhance experiential learning, leadership development, critical thinking, organizational decision-making, and student engagement across multiple academic disciplines. Developed through the Rogers State University Innovation Lab, Simulance AI provides a foundation for continued research, innovation, and educational applications that support student success through AI-enabled experiential learning.

NEW YORK, July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI), today announced a powerful new AI-driven capability that enables bankers and investors to accelerate the creation of client-ready materials directly within S&P Global's Capital IQ Pro platform. The capability will be delivered later this year through a strategic partnership with, and minority investment in, Farsight, a platform for client-ready financial deliverables that produces pitch decks, confidential information memoranda (CIMs) and valuation materials built to each firm's own judgments, prior work templates and standards. S&P Global Market Intelligence will offer the new capability as an add-on to Capital IQ Pro, allowing customers the ability to enhance their experience and drive efficiencies in their workflows, using the AI-powered tool combined with trusted data from Capital IQ Pro. The capability draws on a firm's previous deliverables and proprietary templates to generate highly tailored, client-ready deliverables, including pitch decks, CIMs, valuation materials and more.
